questions.explanation: Past simple – zakończona czynność w określonym czasie.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past simple – A finished action at a definite time: I moved to Wrocław in 2020.

stems: At 8 pm yesterday I ___, so I didn't answer the phone.
questions.explanation: Past continuous – czynność w trakcie w danym momencie przeszłości.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past continuous – An action in progress at a moment in the past: At 8 pm I was working.

stems: When I got to the station, the train ___. I had to wait an hour.
questions.explanation: Past perfect – czynność wcześniejsza od innej przeszłej.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past perfect – When I got to the station, the train had already left.

stems: I ___ for an hour when she finally called.
questions.explanation: Past perfect continuous – jak długo coś trwało do innego momentu w przeszłości.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past perfect continuous – I had been waiting for an hour when she called.

stems: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Dłuższa czynność (past continuous) przerwana krótszą (past simple).
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): I was cooking when the phone rang.

stems: While I ___, he was watching TV.
questions.explanation: While + past continuous – dwie czynności równocześnie.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): While I was reading, he was watching TV.

stems: „When I arrived, she had left.” means that:
correct: she left before I arrived, so I missed her
distractors: she left at the same moment I arrived
she was leaving when I arrived
she used to leave when I arrived
she will leave when I arrive
she had never been there at all
questions.explanation: Past perfect = wcześniej; When I arrived, she left = wyszła po moim przyjściu.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): When I arrived, she had left means she left before I arrived, so I missed her.

stems: I ___ in Poznań when I was a student. (past state)
questions.explanation: Used to – przeszłe nawyki i stany; would – tylko powtarzane czynności, nie stany.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): used to + verb is for past habits and past states: I used to live in Poznań. (❌ I would live in Poznań.)

correct: I would live in Poznań when I was a child.
distractors: Every summer we would go to the lake.
I used to live in Poznań.
We would often visit our grandparents.
She used to have long hair.
I'm used to working from home.
questions.explanation: Would nie wyraża stanów (live, have, know) – tylko powtarzane czynności.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): would + verb is for repeated past actions only, never states (❌ I would live in Poznań.)

stems: After two years in London, I ___ driving on the left. (I'm accustomed to it now)
questions.explanation: Be/get used to + -ing = być przyzwyczajonym; used to + verb = dawny nawyk.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): be/get used to + -ing, which means „be accustomed to”: I'm used to working from home.

stems: I ___ the answer, but I couldn't remember it during the test.
questions.explanation: Know – czasownik stanu, bez form ciągłych.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): ❌ I was knowing the answer. → ✅ I knew the answer.

stems: I ___ him yesterday at the station.
questions.explanation: Podany czas zakończony (yesterday) – past simple, nie present perfect.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): ❌ I have seen him yesterday. → ✅ I saw him yesterday.

stems: I ___ that film – I don't want to watch it again. (no time stated)
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Present perfect: the time isn't stated … I've seen that film.

stems: I ___ really busy this week. (the week isn't over)
questions.explanation: Okres wciąż trwa (this week) – present perfect.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Present perfect … the time period is still going on: I've been busy this week.

stems: She got up, ___ and left for work.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): a series of events: She got up, showered and left.

stems: It ___ heavily when I arrived, so I took a taxi.
questions.explanation: Past continuous – tło wydarzeń w opowiadaniu.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): background to a story: It was raining when I arrived.

stems: Every summer when I was a child, we ___ go to the lake.
questions.explanation: Would + verb – powtarzane czynności w przeszłości.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Every summer we would go to the lake.

stems: Why is the past simple vs. present perfect a frequent problem for Polish speakers?
correct: Polish has only one past tense
distractors: Polish uses would for past habits
Polish has no perfect aspect at all
questions.explanation: W polskim jest jeden czas przeszły, w angielskim wybór zależy od tego, czy czas jest zakończony/podany.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): This is a frequent problem for Polish speakers, because Polish has only one past tense.
